verdict.rationale: cubic's reviews draw on repository-level context in several documented ways. It automatically uses context files such as README.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules and .ai/ directories to pick up existing conventions. It learns unwritten rules from historical senior-engineer reviews and from feedback on its comments. Cross-repo reviews can check shared APIs and schemas in linked repositories, and the MCP server and AI wiki show the codebase itself is indexed. However, no evidence explicitly says PR review comments analyze call sites or related unchanged modules within the same repo, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation that reviews trace call sites and related modules beyond the diff, independent or hands-on evidence of whole-repo-aware comments.
